difficulty_reason: The lemma records that the property of having locally Noetherian fibres and being regular is local in the fppf topology on the target and in the smooth topology on the source. The proof verifies the two locality statements by reducing to the ring-theoretic behaviour of regularity under faithfully flat and smooth base change and then reassembling, so the content is the assembly of the local conditions rather than a new construction. Retained author proof at lines 5763-5799.
